note: Norms behind the Health tab's suggested targets (metrics/targets.js). No personal data. direction: higher or lower is better, range (a healthy span), band (stay near your own baseline). For higher, healthy is the level to reach and cap the further-improvement ceiling; for lower, healthy is the level to get under and cap the floor. A metric with no norm for the owner's sex and age is suggested from their data only.

vo2max.label: VO2 max
vo2max.source: Cooper Institute VO2 max norms for men 50 to 59 (as reprinted in Garmin's VO2 max standard ratings)

resting_hr.label: Resting heart rate
resting_hr.source: Cohorts of middle-aged men (Copenhagen Male Study, CALIBER, Gothenburg): the lowest-risk groups were at or under about 60 bpm

steps.label: Steps
steps.source: Paluch et al. 2022, Lancet Public Health: mortality benefit levels off at 8,000 to 10,000 steps a day under 60, 6,000 to 8,000 at 60 and over

sleep_total_hr.label: Sleep
sleep_total_hr.source: AASM and Sleep Research Society: 7 or more hours for adults (7 to 9 is the usual healthy span)

exercise_min.label: Exercise minutes
exercise_min.source: US Physical Activity Guidelines: 150 to 300 minutes of moderate activity a week (about 30 a day on most days)

cardio_recovery_bpm.label: Cardio recovery

norms.text: more than 12 bpm in the first minute

cardio_recovery_bpm.source: Cole et al. 1999, NEJM: a heart rate drop of 12 bpm or less one minute after exercise was linked to higher mortality

walking_speed_mph.label: Walking speed

norms.text: about 3.2 mph (1.43 m/s, the average for healthy men 50 to 59)

walking_speed_mph.source: Bohannon and Andrews 2011, Physiotherapy: normal walking speed meta-analysis

walking_asymmetry_pct.label: Walking asymmetry
walking_asymmetry_pct.source: iPhone mobility guidance: under about 10% is the usual range

body_fat_pct.label: Body fat
body_fat_pct.source: Tanita healthy body fat ranges (from Gallagher et al. 2000, American Journal of Clinical Nutrition)

visceral_fat.label: Visceral fat
visceral_fat.source: Tanita visceral fat rating: 1 to 12 is the healthy level, 13 to 59 too high

weight_lbs.label: Weight
weight_lbs.source: NIH and CDC: a BMI of 18.5 to 24.9, turned into a weight range for your height

spo2_pct.label: Blood oxygen
spo2_pct.source: General clinical range for healthy adults: 95 to 100%. Discuss with your physician.

breathing_disturbances.label: Breathing disturbances
breathing_disturbances.source: No published per-night norm (Apple flags "elevated" against a lab level of 15 or more events an hour). Discuss with your physician.

hrv_ms.label: Heart rate variability
hrv_ms.source: No reliable published norm for Apple Watch overnight SDNN by age

wrist_temp_f.label: Sleeping wrist temperature
wrist_temp_f.source: A deviation measure: what matters is staying near your own baseline

alcohol.label: Alcoholic drinks per day
alcohol.source: US Dietary Guidelines: 2 drinks or fewer a day for men (1 for women), on days you drink
